topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Rain was coming down in sheets, the kind that peels the paint right off the buildings. Got a call, some dame thinks her car's been towed from her own driveway. Like it’s my first day on this wet, twisted street. I told her, "Nothing's safe in this city, sweetheart, not even your driveway. But I'll see what I can find." Pulled on my coat, lit a smoke, and stepped out into the night. Saw the look in her eyes—same one every mark gets when they realize the world ain't playing by the rules. Time to peel back the layers, dig up the truth. Someone's not telling the whole story, and I aim to find out who.
